results.name: Finset.image_injective
results.source_text:
lemma image_injective (hf : Injective f) : Injective (image f) := by
  simpa only [funext (map_eq_image _)] using! map_injective ⟨f, hf⟩

results.name: Finset.disjoint_image
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem disjoint_image {s t : Finset α} {f : α → β} (hf : Injective f) :
    Disjoint (s.image f) (t.image f) ↔ Disjoint s t :=
  mod_cast Set.disjoint_image_iff hf (s := s) (t := t)

results.name: Finset.disjoint_injOn_union_left
results.source_text:
/-- `· ∪ s` is injective on finsets disjoint from `s`. -/
lemma disjoint_injOn_union_left (s : Finset α) : {t | Disjoint s t}.InjOn (· ∪ s) := by
  grind [Set.InjOn, union_sdiff_cancel_right]
results.docstring: `· ∪ s` is injective on finsets disjoint from `s`.

results.name: Set.injOn_union
results.source_text:
theorem injOn_union (h : Disjoint s₁ s₂) :
    InjOn f (s₁ ∪ s₂) ↔ InjOn f s₁ ∧ InjOn f s₂ ∧ ∀ x ∈ s₁, ∀ y ∈ s₂, f x ≠ f y := by
  refine ⟨fun H => ⟨H.mono subset_union_left, H.mono subset_union_right, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    obtain rfl : x = y := H (Or.inl hx) (Or.inr hy) hxy
    exact h.le_bot ⟨hx, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂, h₁₂⟩
    rintro x (hx | hx) y (hy | hy) hxy
    exacts [h₁ hx hy hxy, (h₁₂ _ hx _ hy hxy).elim, (h₁₂ _ hy _ hx hxy.symm).elim, h₂ hx hy hxy]

results.name: Finset.image
results.docstring: `image f s` is the forward image of `s` under `f`.

results.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_union_disjoint
results.source_text:
lemma ofFinset_union_disjoint (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φs : List 𝓕) (a b : Finset (Fin φs.length))
    (h : Disjoint a b) :
    ofFinset q φs.get a * ofFinset q φs.get b = ofFinset q φs.get (a ∪ b) := by
  rw [ofFinset_union, Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp h]
  simp
